title: AIRunX Settings
description: Configuration settings for AIRunX agent orchestrator

context_location.description: Path to context file (e.g., .ai/context.md). Relative paths are resolved from the settings file location.

mcp_json_location.description: Path to MCP servers configuration file (mcp.json). Relative paths are resolved from the settings file location.

agents_md_location.description: Path to AGENTS.md file defining agent roles. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file location. If null, uses the default AGENTS.md.

pipelines_yaml_location.description: Path to pipelines.yaml file defining workflow stages. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file location. If null, uses the default pipelines.yaml.

default_project_location.description: Default project directory to operate in. If null, uses current working directory.

folders.description: Array of project folders for multi-project support (VSCode workspace compatible). Each entry can be a string path or an object with name and path.

name.description: Display name/alias for the project (defaults to directory basename)

default_backend.description: Default backend to use for agent execution. Backend details are configured in config.yml.

tool_configs.description: Override default tool configuration paths for linting, testing, formatting, etc.

linter_config.description: Path to custom linter config (e.g., eslint.config.js, phpcs.xml)

type_checker_config.description: Path to custom type checker config (e.g., tsconfig.json)

test_runner_config.description: Path to custom test runner config (e.g., vitest.config.ts, phpunit.xml)

coverage_config.description: Path to custom coverage config (often same as test runner config)

security_scanner_config.description: Path to custom security scanner config

approval_mode.description: Approval mode for CLI adapters. Controls permission prompts and sandboxing. 'manual' = interactive prompts, 'auto' = auto-approve all actions, 'yolo' = skip all approvals and sandboxing (DANGEROUS)

gh_pr_title_rules.description: Custom PR title type inference rules. Keys are commit types, values are keyword arrays. Use 'default' key for fallback type.

airunx_signature.description: Include airunx signature badge in PR descriptions

ci_verification_gate.description: After creating a PR, poll GitHub Actions and iterate on CI failures (up to 3 attempts). Requires workflows in the repo; no-ops otherwise. When false, PRs can be marked complete with failing CI.

mark_issue_checkboxes.description: Mark completed checkboxes on source GitHub issues after pipeline completion. The judge agent identifies which checkboxes were satisfied.
